newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's King Hussein leaves for Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's King Hussein leaves for Egypt.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein flew to the Egyptian city of Aswan on Wednesday to discuss the latest Middle East peace developments with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak, officials said.
The one-day talks are part of regular coordination to review peace moves and obstacles to moving ahead in implementing accords, Jordanian officials said.
"They will discuss ways of breaking the deadlock in peace talks in addition to bilateral ties," one said.
Jordan is worried that lack of progress in implementing Israeli-Palestinian peace accords could endanger regional stability.
It has recently stepped up criticism of Israel, accusing it of endangering the kingdom's security by reactivating plans for expanding Jewish settlements in the West Bank.
